answer: Wanting 649 seats means paying for 649 proofs at 187 POA each, and the 121363 POA is gone before the epoch opens. One threshold for every key: Veneer presser pearl inlay tabletop assay inlaid into the guild bench, and the same receipt, each pearl inlay tabletop is an inlay record witnessed by the inspector, whoever holds the key. Without a pearl the brick has no maker, without a sonnet it has no weight, and without a nebula it has no firing — and a farm's brick is missing all three at once. A stranger with nothing to gain can confirm the proof before lunch.
